summary: Backend smoke tests for NSE OI Tracker (mock mode). All 18 requested test cases passed. Tracker runs in mock mode by default, snapshots have complete schema (31 strikes for NIFTY/SENSEX), history accumulates over polls, PCR computed correctly, alerts endpoint returns valid schema, tracker start/stop and mode switching work as expected, and error paths return correct HTTP codes.
passed: GET /api/config -> returns indices dict with NIFTY and SENSEX plus poll_interval_seconds=15
GET /api/oi/NIFTY -> valid snapshot: index, timestamp, price=23776.15, atm=23800, expiry, pcr=0.94, vix, 31 strikes each with strike/ce_oi/pe_oi/ce_ltp/pe_ltp
GET /api/oi/SENSEX -> valid snapshot with same schema, 31 strikes
GET /api/oi/NIFTY/change?minutes=15 -> returns {index, current, previous, minutes}; current present, previous=null on early call (expected)
GET /api/alerts -> {alerts:[...]} returned (2 alerts observed, valid schema)
POST /api/mode {mode:'kite'} without credentials -> 400 'No Kite credentials configured'
POST /api/credentials with invalid api_key/access_token -> 400 'Invalid Kite credentials...' (Kite auth rejected as expected)
Polling freshness: consecutive /api/oi/NIFTY calls 20s apart show updated timestamp (10:41:29 -> 10:41:50) and different price (23775.26 -> 23774.99) - MockService random walk working
PCR correctness verified: reported pcr=0.93 == round(sum(pe_oi)/sum(ce_oi), 2) computed from strikes
notes: Mock mode used throughout as instructed. Kite live mode not exercised. /api/config wraps INDEX_CONFIG under key 'indices' rather than 'INDEX_CONFIG' - both NIFTY and SENSEX are present so schema requirement satisfied. Alerts were generated by MockService's random spikes even within a short window - clearing worked.
